2.23.36
Tablix.TablixRowHierarchy
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The Tablix.TablixRowHierarchy element specifies the row hierarchy of a Tablix. This element MUST
be specified exactly once and is of type TablixHierarchy.
Following is the parent element of the Tablix.TablixRowHierarchy element.
Parent elements
Tablix
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Tablix.TablixRowHierarchy element.
 <xsd:element name="TablixRowHierarchy" type="TablixHierarchyType" minOccurs="1" />
